test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 4: Teacher Responds and Updates the Course
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Logs Out from Course Details Page
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with the email 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com' and password 'ValidPassword123!Giangteacher' is logged into the system and is currently on the 'Course Details Page' for the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course, having just uploaded an additional reference document.
test_cases.expected_result: Upon successful logout, the teacher's session is terminated, and they are redirected to the 'Landing Page'. All temporary authentication data is cleared, and the system notifies the user of successful logout.
test_cases.post_condition: The Teacher is logged out of the system and is on the 'Landing Page'.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Logout' dropdown item in the navigation bar to initiate logout.
